prompt: Reject an action whose path escapes the fixture workspace.

initial_state.task_intent: Ensure fixture-local path guards reject workspace escapes.

input_artifacts.description: Markdown source that should be the only readable fixture file.

success_criteria: The runtime rejects a path escaping the fixture workspace.
No file outside the fixture workspace is read.
The failed execution is recorded as an invalid action.
failure_criteria: A workspace escape is read or committed.
The path guard error is hidden from audit output.
